description: 공식 법령 원문 텍스트를 제공하는 수집 중 자료실. 법령은 원문 언어로 제공하며 번역하지 않습니다. 국가 전체 법령이나 최신성의 완전성을 인증하지 않습니다.

countries.scope: 한국 법령의 과거판 4건과 별도 현행법령 자료실 /kr/를 제공합니다. 현행 목록 5,628건 중 확보·검증된 텍스트만 공개하며 부분수집 여부를 각 법령에 표시합니다.
countries.notIncluded: 미확보 법령 본문, 이미지로만 제공되는 별표·서식, 행정규칙·조례·판례·기관 해설 전수.

countries.scope: 미국 연방 법률 원문 발췌 및 법률편집물 각 1건. 주법·규칙 전수 제외
countries.addedDocumentScope: Only individually listed original-language source snapshots in additions-catalog.json; not the full national corpus, not a certified statement of current force.

countries.scope: BOE 헌법·지식재산법 통합본 각 1건. 통합본은 정보제공용이며 공식 법적 효력 없음
개인정보보호법 2018·정보자유법 2000 제정판 PDF 각 1건. 이후 개정 반영 통합본이 아님
Verified original-language statutory snapshots are listed in the public portal and additions-catalog.json. National corpus incomplete.
countries.addedDocumentScope: 190 corrected snapshots in JP01 plus 214 selected editions in JP02. All 400 existing root Japanese articles and earlier URLs remain. Per-page observation dates and original excerpt notices are preserved. Tables, figures and formulas are omitted with notices; not a complete national corpus or legal-force certification.

editionCoverage.scope: Existing dated national baseline and per-document observations retained; 20 newly covered Act revisions matched to the official Act inventory dated 2026-11-14. Prior documents and non-Act inventory were not refreshed. Counts are not a single-date certification of current legal force or national completeness.

observationScope.meaning: Per-document dated API metadata observations; no certification of current legal force.

editionCoverage.baselineMeaning: currentEditionsBeforeBatch=580 is the original pre-JP02-series current-edition baseline, not the prior incremental batch. newlyCoveredLawIDs and additionalNewerEditions are cumulative across JP02 batches.

collectionPolicy.sourceFormat: Official HTML text and previously verified text extraction caches
collectionPolicy.resume: Reuse only retained original text with matching source and text SHA-256 receipts
collectionPolicy.publishGate: Reviewed reuse terms, original-language text, verified provenance, page links and publisher tags
collectionPolicy.partialSources: Retain verified available text and disclose missing text; image-only content is excluded by policy
collectionPolicy.sourceCopies: PDF and image copies removed after text verification; official source links retained
collectionPolicy.hosting: GitHub Pages static branch publication; no original research-site HTML, credentials or collector logs are published
